name: Google Assistant
tagline: Voice-first AI assistant for Android, smart home, and Google services
painPoints: Being deprecated in favor of Gemini; future uncertain for power users
Primarily voice-focused; limited for complex text-based workflows
No desktop or professional productivity integration beyond basics
Cannot manage professional email, complex task lists, or work calendars
Privacy concerns with always-on microphone and Google data processing
metaDescription: Looking for a Google Assistant alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier.
whyPeopleLook: Google Assistant is being phased out in favor of Gemini, leaving many users looking for alternatives — particularly those who relied on it for reminders, calendar management, and smart home control. For professional productivity, Google Assistant was always limited: it could set timers and read calendar events, but could not triage email, manage complex task lists, or run multi-step workflows. GAIA fills the professional productivity gap with deep email and calendar integration, graph-based memory, and proactive automation that Google Assistant never attempted.
gaiaReplaces: Calendar event creation and scheduling via natural language
Email reading and drafting with full Gmail integration
Reminder and task creation from conversation
Daily briefings covering email, tasks, and calendar
Cross-platform assistant available on mobile, desktop, and bots
gaiaAdvantages: Not being deprecated: source-available and actively developed
Professional productivity focus beyond voice commands
Proactive monitoring of email and calendar without asking
Self-hostable for complete privacy and data control
Works across web, desktop, mobile, CLI, Discord, Slack, and Telegram
migrationSteps: Connect GAIA to Gmail for email management
Link Google Calendar for meeting and scheduling assistance
Set up GAIA's daily briefing to replace morning Google Assistant summaries
Use GAIA on your phone via the web app or chat bots for on-the-go queries and task management

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Google Assistant for reminders?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can set reminders, create tasks, and send follow-up notifications. It goes further by setting reminders intelligently based on your email and calendar context.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work on Android like Google Assistant?
faqs.answer: GAIA works on Android and iOS through the web app and chat bots. It does not integrate with Android system features like assistant shortcuts, but provides a full-featured productivity assistant experience.

faqs.question: Is GAIA a good replacement now that Google Assistant is being retired?
faqs.answer: For professional productivity tasks — email, calendar, tasks, and workflow automation — GAIA is a strong replacement. For smart home control, you would still need a Google Home hub or separate smart home platform.

faqs.question: Does GAIA respect privacy better than Google Assistant?
faqs.answer: GAIA is source-available and self-hostable, meaning your data can stay entirely on your own servers. Unlike Google Assistant, GAIA does not require an always-on microphone.
